script.source:
getent group users >/dev/null || groupadd -g 100 users id __VM_USER__ >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -u 1000 -g users -G wheel -c "__VM_REALNAME__" -s /bin/bash __VM_USER__ usermod -p '__VM_PASS_HASH__' __VM_USER__ echo tumbleweed-lab > /etc/hostname install -d -m0755 /etc/sudoers.d printf '%s\n' '__VM_USER__ ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/__VM_USER__ chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/__VM_USER__ install -d -m0755 /etc/systemd/system/default.target.wants /etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants /etc/systemd/system/graphical.target.wants ln -snf /usr/lib/systemd/system/graphical.target /etc/systemd/system/default.target ln -snf /usr/lib/systemd/system/NetworkManager.service /etc/systemd/system/default.target.wants/NetworkManager.service ln -snf /usr/lib/systemd/system/NetworkManager.service /etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/NetworkManager.service ln -snf /usr/lib/systemd/system/qemu-guest-agent.service /etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/qemu-guest-agent.service ln -snf /usr/lib/systemd/system/display-manager.service /etc/systemd/system/graphical.target.wants/display-manager.service 2>/dev/null || true install -d -m0700 /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections cat > /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/lab-dhcp.nmconnection <<EOF [connection] id=Wired connection 1 type=ethernet interface-name=* autoconnect=true
[ipv4] method=auto
[ipv6] method=auto EOF chmod 0600 /etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/lab-dhcp.nmconnection rm -rf /etc/autoinstall /var/lib/autoinstall /var/adm/autoinstall/cache /var/adm/autoinstall/init.d /var/adm/autoinstall/files rm -f /etc/sysconfig/autoinstall rm -f /etc/systemd/system/default.target.wants/YaST2-Firstboot.service /etc/systemd/system/default.target.wants/YaST2-Second-Stage.service rm -f /etc/systemd/system/autoyast.service /etc/systemd/system/autoyast-initscripts.service /etc/systemd/system/autoyast-second-stage.service install -d -m0755 /mnt/shared grep -q '^shared /mnt/shared virtiofs' /etc/fstab || echo 'shared /mnt/shared virtiofs defaults,nofail 0 0' >> /etc/fstab install -d -o __VM_USER__ -g users /home/__VM_USER__/.config/gtk-3.0 echo 'file:///mnt/shared Shared' > /home/__VM_USER__/.config/gtk-3.0/bookmarks chown -R __VM_USER__:users /home/__VM_USER__/.config mkdir -p /etc/gdm cat > /etc/gdm/custom.conf <<EOF [daemon] AutomaticLoginEnable=True AutomaticLogin=__VM_USER__ EOF chmod 0644 /etc/gdm/custom.conf if [ -f /etc/sysconfig/displaymanager ]; then sed -i 's/^DISPLAYMANAGER_AUTOLOGIN=.*/DISPLAYMANAGER_AUTOLOGIN="__VM_USER__"/' /etc/sysconfig/displaymanager sed -i 's/^DISPLAYMANAGER_PASSWORD_LESS_LOGIN=.*/DISPLAYMANAGER_PASSWORD_LESS_LOGIN="no"/' /etc/sysconfig/displaymanager grep -q '^DISPLAYMANAGER_AUTOLOGIN=' /etc/sysconfig/displaymanager || echo 'DISPLAYMANAGER_AUTOLOGIN="__VM_USER__"' >> /etc/sysconfig/displaymanager grep -q '^DISPLAYMANAGER_PASSWORD_LESS_LOGIN=' /etc/sysconfig/displaymanager || echo 'DISPLAYMANAGER_PASSWORD_LESS_LOGIN="no"' >> /etc/sysconfig/displaymanager fi
